Generate R bindings from Zig exports

Source: R/document.R
document.Rd

Scans the Zig source of the package with scan_exports(), renders the bindings with render_bindings(), and writes them: the Zig manifest src/rzig/framework/generated/manifest.zig, the R wrappers R/rzig-wrappers.R, a managed block in NAMESPACE, and a help page man/<name>.Rd for every exported function, written from its Zig doc comment (the first paragraph is the title and description; @param, @return, @examples, @details, @seealso, @references and @note fill the matching sections). Lines of NAMESPACE outside the block and help pages that rzig did not write are kept. The function is pure R; no Zig compiler is needed.

Usage

document(path)

Arguments

path

Path to a package previously initialized with use_rzig().

Value

The rzig_bindings object that was written, with the element files naming the files written, invisibly.

Details

When roxygen2 generates NAMESPACE (its first line is # Generated by roxygen2: do not edit by hand), the useDynLib directive is written into R/rzig-wrappers.R as a @rawNamespace tag, and NAMESPACE receives the same lines roxygen2 writes from the tags. The package then works whichever of document(), roxygen2::roxygenise() or devtools::document() ran last; run document() after changing an exported Zig signature so that the wrappers follow it. roxygen2 then writes the help pages from the wrappers, and document() writes none.

Run document() after every change to an exported Zig signature or its documentation comment, and before installing the package.

Examples

package_path <- tempfile("rzig-document-", tmpdir = tempdir())
dir.create(package_path)
writeLines(c("Package: examplepkg", "Version: 0.0.1"),
  file.path(package_path, "DESCRIPTION"))
use_rzig(package_path)
#> Generated RZig bindings for examplepkg: 1 exported function
#> Created RZig scaffold for package examplepkg
bindings <- document(package_path)
#> Generated RZig bindings for examplepkg: 1 exported function
bindings$files
#> [1] "src/rzig/framework/generated/manifest.zig"
#> [2] "R/rzig-wrappers.R"                        
#> [3] "NAMESPACE"                                
#> [4] "man/hello_zig.Rd"                         
cat(readLines(file.path(package_path, "NAMESPACE")), sep = "\n")
#> # Generated by rzig::document(): begin
#> useDynLib("examplepkg",
#>   hello_zig_ = "hello_zig"
#> )
#> export("hello_zig")
#> # Generated by rzig::document(): end
unlink(package_path, recursive = TRUE)
